column1: # *** THE 1812 GODPARENTS: SERENA OR LERENA - 14 September 2026. ***
# The Montevideo baptism of 15 May 1812 has been the archive's best candidate for the machine's S-for-L
# slip, and also the place where the archive talked itself out of a correct reading on a bad age
# calculation. *** Item 12 of the fifteen was to open the image at magnification. The handwriting was
# still not reached - but something better than a guess was. ***
*** FAMILYSEARCH'S OWN IMAGE INDEX READS 'LERENA', NOT 'SERENA' ***
column2: The image index panel for ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-X7PG-M (Uruguay, Catholic Church Records; film 007713375, image 2567) lists eleven people on the page. Two of them are: *** 'Juan Agustin LERENA' (Male) and 'Agustina ALERENA' (Female). *** *** The AI full-text transcript of the SAME image renders those two names 'Juan Agustin SERENA' and 'Dona Agustina PERENA'. ***
column3: *** SECONDARY - a second reading of the image by FamilySearch's indexing pipeline. THE HANDWRITING WAS NOT READ HERE: *** the viewer's index overlay could not be dismissed, so no tile of the hand was ever seen by this archive.
column4: *** This is the sixth S-for-L on this family, and the first time an independent reading has CONTRADICTED the machine on one. *** Everywhere else the archive inferred the slip; here two different FamilySearch pipelines disagree with each other about the same ink, and the index says L. *** Taken with the ages - Juan Agustin was 21 in 1812 and Agustina 17, from the padron read the same day - the reading that these are Sancho's two eldest children is now supported from three directions: *** the names, the ages, and an independent transcription. *** It is still not this archive reading the hand, and the row says so. ***

column1: *** AND THE SAME INDEX CONFIRMS THE BRIDE'S FAMILY ***
column2: The eleven indexed names are: Bonifacia Agustina (the child, born 14 May 1812, christened 15 May); Feliz Malbarea and Micaela Fernandez (parents); Bernardo Malbares and Manuel[a] Lozano (paternal grandparents); *** RODRIGO FERNANDEZ and ROSA FERNANDEZ (maternal grandparents); *** Juan Agustin Lerena and Agustina Alerena (godparents); Pedro Jose Guri Ju, Doctor; and Ignacio Nepomuceno on the next act.
column4: *** RODRIGO FERNANDEZ and ROSA FERNANDEZ are exactly the couple the Geneanet trees give as the parents of JOSEFA FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS, Sancho's wife. *** So Micaela Fernandez, the mother at this font, is Josefa's sister, *** and the two godparents are the baby's first cousins - which is the most ordinary godparent choice there is, and explains why two Lerena teenagers are standing at a Malbarea baptism at all. *** *** This archive called that relationship 'a PLAUSIBILITY, not a finding' in September. *** It is still not an act read here, but it now has an index behind it as well as a tree, and the 1812 padron independently puts Rodrigo Fernandez, 63, asturiano, living in Sancho's household.
